when.sr: Kad se prevara dešava upravo sada: neko je na putu do vas po novac, zlato ili karticu, ili lažni policajac, lekar ili „kurir” stoji pred vratima. Pozovite sami, nikada preko broja koji vam neko da.
when.en: When the fraud is happening right now: someone is on the way to collect cash, gold or a card, or a fake police officer, doctor or “courier” is at the door. Dial it yourself, never through a number someone gives you.

when.sr: Za prijavu prevare ili pokušaja prevare: pozovite 192 ili podnesite prijavu u najbližoj policijskoj stanici. Ponesite poruke, snimke ekrana, brojeve računa i potvrde o uplati.
when.en: To report a fraud or attempted fraud: call 192 or file a report at the nearest police station. Bring the messages, screenshots, account numbers and payment receipts.

name.en: Sajber straža (Ministry of Interior): report online fraud

when.sr: Nacionalna platforma MUP-a za prijavu internet prevara, lažnih prodavnica i domena, fišing poruka, investicionih prevara, preuzetih naloga i drugih oblika visokotehnološkog kriminala. Prijava se prosleđuje Službi za borbu protiv visokotehnološkog kriminala i nadležnom tužilaštvu.
when.en: The Ministry of Interior’s national platform for reporting online fraud, fake shops and domains, phishing messages, investment fraud, hijacked accounts and other high-tech crime. Reports go to the High-Tech Crime Service and the competent prosecutor.

when.sr: Odmah ako ste upisali podatke kartice, PIN ili kod za potvrdu, prijavili se preko linka iz poruke ili uplatili novac prevarantu: tražite blokadu kartice i aplikacije i proverite transakcije. Kada banka primi prijavu zloupotrebe, rizik daljih transakcija prelazi na banku. Zovite samo broj sa poleđine kartice, iz aplikacije ili sa zvaničnog sajta banke.
when.en: Straight away if you entered card details, a PIN or a confirmation code, logged in through a link from a message or paid a scammer: ask for your card and app to be blocked and check your transactions. Once the bank has your report of misuse, the risk of further transactions moves to the bank. Only call the number on the back of your card, in the app or on the bank’s official website.

label.sr: Broj sa poleđine kartice ili iz aplikacije banke
label.en: The number on the back of your card or in your bank’s app

name.sr: Nacionalni CERT Republike Srbije: prijava incidenta
name.en: National CERT of Serbia: incident reporting

when.sr: Prijavite lažne sajtove, fišing SMS poruke i mejlove i lažne stranice u ime pošte, banaka ili državnih organa, da bi CERT mogao da upozori druge. Ne zamenjuje prijavu policiji ili Sajber straži.
when.en: Report fake websites, phishing texts and emails, and fake pages in the name of the post, banks or state bodies, so CERT can warn others. It does not replace a report to the police or Sajber straža.

name.sr: Narodna banka Srbije: zaštita korisnika finansijskih usluga
name.en: National Bank of Serbia: financial consumer protection

when.sr: Ako je banka odbila da vam vrati novac skinut sa kartice ili računa bez vašeg odobrenja, ili nije odgovorila na prigovor u roku od 15 dana: podnesite pritužbu ili predlog za posredovanje Narodnoj banci Srbije. Postupak je besplatan.
when.en: If your bank refused to refund money taken from your card or account without your authorisation, or did not answer your complaint within 15 days: file a complaint or a mediation proposal with the National Bank of Serbia. The procedure is free.

label.sr: Pritužba na banku ili pružaoca platnih usluga
label.en: Complaint about a bank or payment provider

when.sr: Pre nego što bilo šta platite ili upišete zbog poruke o pošiljci: proverite kod Pošte Srbije da li pošiljka zaista postoji. Pošta ne traži lične podatke ni plaćanje preko linka.
when.en: Before paying or entering anything because of a parcel message: check with Pošta Srbije whether the parcel really exists. The post does not ask for personal data or payment through a link.
